text: all the cars are driving backwards lmao and then they turn the road and disappear
resolution: Fixed the two traffic bugs the user saw. (1) BACKWARDS: the buildVehicle model's front is -Z (hood + front_lights baked at -halfLength, trunk at +Z), but the loader faced +Z to travel — world_loader.zig stepTraffic now rotates the body heading+180 so the front leads. (2) VANISH AT TURNS: traceFlowCircuit returned OPEN walks (it preferred straight and ran into dead-ends), and an open route teleport-wraps from its end back to a distant start mid-drive; the tracer now closes on the FIRST REVISITED cell (a guaranteed cycle, lead-in tail discarded) and bakeTrafficVehicles takes CLOSED loops only. To keep density with few clean loops, the bake now collects every DISTINCT closed loop by deterministic straight-follow from each seed cell (an rng-explore attempt was tried and reverted — random turning just dead-ends before cycling on this map) and spreads the vehicle count across them round-robin at random phases. Verified: 8/8 P4 traffic tests, rebuilt loader + re-baked + self-shot — 14 varied cars facing forward on the lane-marked streets, no teleport. NOTE: editor loader pane needs 'rjit ship hmsc-int' to pick up the framework change. SHA 4f5feb912.
